post.caption: The Pink Panther began as a flaw. In the 1963 film, a princess owns a famous pink diamond, and a tiny flaw inside it looks like a leaping panther. That flaw gives the stone its nickname. The film's animated opening credits turn the diamond into a pink cartoon panther. Friz Freleng directed the titles, and Henry Mancini scored them. United Artists liked them so much it ordered cartoon shorts. The first short, The Pink Phink, won an Oscar in 1964. The Pink Panther Show reached NBC on September 6, 1969.
